d: Short, spiky jet-black hair with a prominent shock of platinum white sweeping across the forehead, paired with a sharp, narrow blue eye and a mature, stern facial expression. The lean, athletic build is clad in a high-tech tactical ensemble consisting of a grey and charcoal armored chest piece with orange accents, layered under a tan-colored hooded cloak. A black fabric blindfold covers the right eye, tied around the head, while a metallic, scale-textured mechanical arm is visible on the left side.
